description: This Java class 'VisitAttribute' models a user-defined attribute for a visit within the OpenMRS medical record system. It extends the 'BaseAttribute' class, associating a 'VisitAttributeType' with a specific 'Visit' instance, and includes methods for getting and setting its properties, as well as metadata annotations for auditing.

classes.name: VisitAttribute
classes.description: A class representing a custom attribute attached to a visit in the OpenMRS system, supporting auditing and association with specific visit instances.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this visit attribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this visit attribute.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves the visit to which this attribute belongs.

methods.name: setVisit
methods.description: Associates this attribute with a specific visit.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the internally stored ID for this visit attribute.

methods.name: setVisitAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the internal ID for this visit attribute.
